read_fwf_basic_fixed_width: read fixed-width format data from a string and auto-detect column positions into a DataFrame
read_fwf_with_colspecs: read fixed-width format data using explicit column start and end position tuples
read_fwf_with_widths: read fixed-width format data using a list of column widths to parse each field
read_fwf_with_custom_delimiter: read fixed-width format data with a non-space filler character like tilde as delimiter
read_fwf_with_datetime_index: read fixed-width format data with a datetime index parsed from a custom date format string
read_fwf_with_comment_lines: read fixed-width format data while skipping lines that start with a comment character
read_fwf_skip_blank_lines: read fixed-width format data and skip blank lines during parsing
read_fwf_thousands_separator: read fixed-width format data with a custom thousands separator character for numeric columns
read_fwf_with_converters: read fixed-width format data using converter functions for custom column type conversion
read_fwf_with_compression: read fixed-width format data from a compressed file with inferred or explicit compression type
read_fwf_chunked_iterator: read fixed-width format data in chunks using an iterator with skiprows and chunksize
read_fwf_with_nullable_dtype_backend: read fixed-width format data with nullable integer, float, boolean, and string dtypes via dtype_backend
